{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    # Rectangular grids made of vertical monochrome stripes, as in the example.
    h = rng.randint(2, 6)
    w = rng.randint(2, 6)
    palette = [6, 8, 9]
    # choose a permutation, allowing repeated stripe colors for varied counts
    cols = [rng.choice(palette) for _ in range(w)]
    # ensure the grid has at least two visible stripe colors
    if len(set(cols)) == 1:
        cols[rng.randrange(w)] = rng.choice([c for c in palette if c != cols[0]])
    return [[cols[x] for x in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]"}
